arguments.sql_query:
WITH doac_ingredients AS (
    SELECT concept_id, concept_name
    FROM omop.concept
    WHERE concept_id IN (43013024, 40241331, 40228152, 45775372, 45892847)
),
doac_exposures AS (
    SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date, di.concept_name AS doac
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
      ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    JOIN doac_ingredients di
      ON di.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
    WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
),
first_doac AS (
    SELECT person_id, MIN(index_date) AS index_date
    FROM doac_exposures
    GROUP BY person_id
),
first_doac_named AS (
    SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, MIN(e.doac) AS doac
    FROM first_doac f
    JOIN doac_exposures e
      ON e.person_id = f.person_id AND e.index_date = f.index_date
    GROUP BY f.person_id, f.index_date
),
af_desc AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 313217
    UNION SELECT 313217
),
bleed_desc AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (192671, 439847, 376713, 432923, 439040, 4338544, 4100660)
    UNION SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (192671, 439847, 376713, 432923, 439040, 4338544, 4100660)
),
af_new_doac AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.person_id, f.index_date, f.doac
    FROM first_doac_named f
    JOIN omop.observation_period op
      ON op.person_id = f.person_id
     AND f.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date
     AND op.observation_period_start_date <= DATEADD(day, -365, f.index_date)
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
        JOIN af_desc a ON a.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
        WHERE co.person_id = f.person_id
          AND co.condition_start_date <= f.index_date
    )
),
bleed30 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.person_id
    FROM af_new_doac c
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
      ON co.person_id = c.person_id
     AND co.condition_start_date BETWEEN c.index_date AND DATEADD(day, 30, c.index_date)
    JOIN bleed_desc b ON b.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS new_doac_af_users,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS major_bleed_within_30d,
    CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(10,2)) AS percent_with_major_bleed_30d
FROM af_new_doac c
LEFT JOIN bleed30 b ON b.person_id = c.person_id;

content.text:
Among **new DOAC users with atrial fibrillation**, major-bleeding diagnosis codes were recorded within 30 days for:

- **367 / 15,897 patients**
- **2.31%** within 30 days of first DOAC exposure

Definition used:
- DOACs: apixaban, rivaroxaban, dabigatran/dabigatran etexilate, edoxaban
- “New user”: first observed DOAC exposure with ≥365 days prior observation
- AF: atrial fibrillation diagnosis on/before DOAC start
- Bleeding: OMOP descendants of GI hemorrhage, intracranial/cerebral/subarachnoid/subdural hemorrhage, lower/acute GI hemorrhage concepts

So the short answer is: **about 2.3% had a major-bleeding code within 30 days.**
